[CONTRIBUTION EVENT]
- Type: Time (Minutes)
- Amount: 45
- Description: Governor rulings — Oscar batch placement (B), dual 0.1 kg butter consumption, 4.80 kg target
  
  Pull requests (GitHub evidence):
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1847
  
  Details:
  Governor time for Gary Teh on the AGL13 Oscar/Vivi butter reconciliation, 2026-11-14. Filed on his instruction: "File contribution report for time spent by you and me check transcription records".
  
  SEVEN SUBSTANTIVE DIRECTIVES, FOUR OF THEM CORRECTING THE AGENT
  1. "Use 0.1 cacao butter" -- set the butter quantity for the Vivi bar conversion, unblocking the cost model. Verified 0.1 kg was already booked in four legs (MAIN r6045 -0.1, AGL13 r49 +0.1, AGL13 r52 -0.1, AGL13 net 0.0); confirmed equity $111.80 = $108.36 bars + $3.44 butter.
  2. "Loop till completed" -- authorized autonomous continuation through the remaining backlog without per-step approval.
  3. "Oscar's should even be in AGL13" -- raised the batch-placement question the agent had not asked.
  4. "It should be B" -- ruled the Oscar batch must come OUT of AGL13 entirely. This reversed the agent's structural assumption that the batch legitimately lived in the conversion shop.
  5. "Does the unit cost account for the 100gram of cacao butter? Has the 100gram of cacao butter been recorded as consumed on our ledger?" -- the question that surfaced the un-capitalized $3.44 per batch and forced the distinction between "booked as depletion" and "booked into unit cost".
  6. "0.1 cacao butter consumed for the Vivi chocolate bars via AGL13 / 0.1 cacao butter consumed for Oscar chocolate bars via MAIN / Balance should be 4.8kg" -- corrected the agent's error in reversing r6056 as a duplicate. Established that there were two legitimate 0.1 kg consumptions, one per batch via different ledgers, and fixed the target balance at 4.80 kg.
  7. "File contribution report for time spent by you and me check transcription records" -- directed use of transcription records rather than estimates for time attribution.
  
  WHY THIS IS HIGH-VALUE DISCRIMINATOR WORK
  Directive 6 caught a real agent error: the agent had reversed MAIN r6056 as an "unbacked duplicate debit" after concluding no second 0.1 kg was consumed. Had that stood, MAIN butter would have read 4.9 kg and the Vivi batch would have had no butter consumption leg at all -- a silent $3.44 overstatement of assets plus a batch costed without its butter. The agent's own supporting evidence (offchain asset location at 4.9 kg) was consistent with the wrong conclusion, so the error was not self-detectable from the books alone.
  
  Directive 5 opened a second, still-unresolved defect: composition 7b9d3b16 lists only nibs + packaging, so both bar keys are capitalized at $2.709/bar while $3.44/batch of butter left inventory. $6.88 of asset value currently sits between inventory and finished goods.
  
  TIME DERIVATION (transparency: measured for the agent, bounded for the governor)
  - Session window 00:20:42 -> 02:52:25 UTC, 151.7 min wall clock, 240 LLM rounds -- governor present and engaged throughout at fast turnaround.
  - Six inter-round gaps exceed 3 min: 48.8, 9.0, 6.0, 4.8, 4.8, 4.2 min. Excluding the 48.8 min outlier (stepped away) leaves 28.8 min of bounded deliberation across the remaining five.
  - Added to that, reading six dense ledger reconciliations and composing rulings on the fast turns.
  - Filed at 45 min as a deliberately conservative engaged-time figure. Per-message governor timestamps are not recorded in the debug log (assistant rounds only), so this is bounded rather than measured. Governor may override.
- Contributor(s): Gary Teh
- TDG Issued: 75.00
- Attached Filename: N/A
- Destination Contribution File Location: N/A
--------
